units.name: Fetch full texts
units.necessity: Obtains the PDFs the depth asks for; the only networked step of the fusion block (slide 4).
units.trigger: GATE-a4-check passed; again for a top-up (LOOP-08) or for the questions' attack targets (LOOP-07).
units.legacy_deviation: Slide 4 draws one A6 card; the implementation splits it into A6.d and A6.c (D-04).

side_effects: PDF downloads (paper_pdf MCP: Unpaywall -> PMC -> arXiv -> IEEE; arXiv by curl ~1 request / 3 s)

commands: (paywalls ate the budget? once:) ideate_tools.py tier1 $RD --top-up
preconditions: GATE-a4-check passed (keys final: every PDF is named after its key)
logic: pick candidates by depth: quick none, standard the 20 best by composite, deep every Tier 1 paper
fetch each PDF by DOI over the open-access routes, then arXiv
record every attempt with route, result and reason
replace paywalled papers once (top-up)
verify each PDF is complete (%PDF- ... %%EOF)
units.state: Per topic; attempts logged so a re-run skips settled candidates.

error_boundary.local_recovery: paywalled -> abstract-only and continue; still short after the top-up -> caveat fulltext-short
error_boundary.escalation: hard stop on a second top-up or when the paper_pdf server errors (then no paper is recorded as tried)

units.idempotency: A complete PDF already on disk is not fetched again; the top-up is refused a second time (F04).
units.security: Outbound to open-access PDF routes and arxiv.org; F05 checks that no credential appears in written files or the paper_pdf log.

verdict.problem: Full texts change what deconstruction can claim; access must be recorded per paper.
verdict.why_separate: Network fetch fails differently from conversion and resumes differently.
verdict.if_removed: Fusion would run on abstracts only (abstract-heavy caveat).
verdict.merge: Merged with A6.c on the slide; kept split (D-04).
verdict.boundary: Three owned files; candidates carry added_by.
verdict.quality: L2 (11/12): arXiv downloads use curl and bypass record/replay.
verdict.alternatives: Fetch inside A7.D (rejected: mixes network into judgement).
verdict.evidence: ideate_units.json A6.d achieved L2; slide 4 A6 card.
verdict.benefits: Replayable full-text acquisition once arXiv goes through the recorded transport.
verdict.risks: Replay gap means fetch behaviour cannot be regression-tested offline.
verdict.actions: Route arXiv PDF downloads through the recorded transport; add the replay test (reach L4).

units.name: Convert full texts
units.necessity: Turns every fetched PDF into UTF-8/LF markdown plus caption pages, and sets each paper's access level.
units.trigger: After A6.d; again whenever A6.d brings new PDFs.

side_effects: pdf2md service calls (run in the background before the Unit's commands)

logic: convert with pdf2md; fall back to local pdftotext
extract pages that carry a figure or table caption (table numbers are read from the page image)
normalise every full text to UTF-8, LF, no NUL
set access_level per shortlisted paper
units.state: figure/_processed.json records the hash of each PDF processed; a changed PDF is reprocessed.

error_boundary.local_recovery: pdf2md down -> pdftotext (caveat fulltext-plain); nothing converts -> pdf-only (caveat pdf-unconverted)

units.idempotency: Keyed by PDF hash; re-running on unchanged PDFs changes nothing.
units.security: Sends PDFs to the pdf2md service (PDF2MD_API_KEY); open-access content only; key never logged.

verdict.problem: Fusion reads text, not PDFs; access level must match files.
verdict.why_separate: Conversion fails and resumes independently of fetching.
verdict.if_removed: A7.D could not read full texts.
verdict.boundary: Owns the full-text tree and the access_level part.
verdict.quality: L2 (11/12): pdf2md is an external call outside record/replay; on Windows the F12 LF check fails (baseline).
verdict.evidence: ideate_units.json A6.c; baseline test failures on Windows (CRLF).
verdict.risks: Converted text quality varies by route.
verdict.actions: Write LF explicitly on all platforms; record pdf2md answers for replay (reach L4).

units.name: Per-paper deconstruction
units.necessity: Takes each paper apart on its own - claims with strength and scope, premises, limitations, future work, what it did not do, experiment rows, vocabulary - with every quote verified verbatim.
units.trigger: A6.c done (or full texts recorded as missing); per paper; again on a declared revision from B3 (LOOP-06) or new full texts (LOOP-07).
preconditions: A6.c done or the fulltext block never ran (abstract-only topic)
logic: plan batches (full text and abstract batches)
one subagent per batch reads only its own paper: claims, premises, limitations, future work, not-done, matrix rows, terms
merge verifies every quote verbatim against the source and rejects paraphrase
abstract-only records are limited in the number of claims
write one record per citation key (schema ai-scientist-decon/1)
units.state: One record per key; revisions are declared and mark downstream stale.

error_boundary.local_recovery: no full text -> abstract-only record; more than half abstract-only -> abstract-heavy (must disclose)
error_boundary.escalation: hard stop on a frozen hand-written knowledge base or without a shortlist

units.idempotency: Keyed by citation key and source hash; an unchanged paper is not re-read.
units.security: No network; subagents see one paper each (no cross-paper leakage by design).

verdict.problem: Comparisons made while reading mix papers and invent agreement.
verdict.why_separate: 'Each paper looks only at itself' is the block's first invariant.
verdict.if_removed: Alignment and collisions would have no per-paper records to cite.
verdict.merge: Not with A7.A* (that would compare before aligning).
verdict.duplication: Replaces the legacy reading notes (Pass 1), which are now a view.
verdict.boundary: One record per key; verbatim-quote check.
verdict.cost_risk: Part of the 2.64 M token fusion run (golf50: 10 full texts + 40 abstracts -> 179 claims).
verdict.benefits: Every later sentence can point to a quoted record.

units.name: Vocabulary
units.necessity: Puts every word the records use on one vocabulary (one concept per thing named; false friends split per paper; measures defined by several papers carry an equivalence note).
units.trigger: GATE-decon-check passed; again on an incommensurable collision (LOOP-05).
logic: tool lists every term with its papers (worklist)
model writes one coherent vocabulary
align-set checks it (A01-A08, A13) and projects the methods-matrix input
units.state: Per topic; revised by declared instance (--reason); history kept.

error_boundary.local_recovery: failing vocabulary is rejected whole and rewritten

units.idempotency: Same vocabulary -> same part hash; nothing downstream goes stale.

verdict.problem: Papers use one word for different things and different words for one thing; comparing them raw produces false conflicts.
verdict.why_separate: 'Align first, then compare' is the block's second invariant.
verdict.if_removed: Collision candidates would be found by string match.
verdict.merge: With A7.A2 is conceivable, but coordinates depend on a settled vocabulary.
verdict.boundary: Owns the vocab part of alignment.json and the matrix projection.
verdict.alternatives: Embedding clustering of terms (no definitions, no false-friend split).
verdict.risks: A wrong merge hides a real conflict (LOOP-05 repairs).

units.name: Coordinates
units.necessity: Gives every claim and premise six coordinates (construct, measure, population, data, split, method family) so collisions are found by position, not by wording.
logic: tool suggests coordinates from text and matrix rows
--auto applies unambiguous ones
model settles ambiguous ones (--apply)
checks A09-A11

error_boundary.local_recovery: a unit without coordinates fails A09 and is reapplied

units.idempotency: Coordinates keyed by unit id; reapplying identical values is a no-op.

verdict.problem: Without positions, comparison candidates cannot be listed by rule.
verdict.risks: Coarse coordinates over-generate candidates (capped by depth).

units.name: Concept points
units.necessity: Turns concepts reached by >= 2 papers into concept Points (counted, not remembered) for the knowledge base.
logic: tool lists concepts reached by >= 2 papers
model decides which become cards and writes their fields
build-cards validates and renders
quick depth marks cards needs_fulltext

error_boundary.local_recovery: unit-done stays pending until A12 passes

verdict.problem: Concept Points summarise shared vocabulary for readers and for Plane Q2.
verdict.why_separate: Card writing is a model task distinct from coordinate setting.
verdict.if_removed: The question path (X1 -> X2 -> B3 -> B3.5 -> F.9) is unaffected; Planes lose their concept section.
verdict.merge: Could be folded into A7.R2 (Planes), which is its only consumer.
verdict.dependencies: A7.A2; its consumer A7.R2 does not declare it (covered by GATE-align-check).
verdict.cost_risk: Moderate tokens; blocks align-check although no question depends on it.
verdict.alternatives: Generate Points as a view from the vocabulary.
verdict.evidence: registry: A7.A3 invalidates only A7.R2 (Plane Q2).
verdict.benefits: Making it non-blocking would shorten the path to questions.
verdict.risks: Readers of the knowledge base lose concept cards if dropped.
verdict.actions: Keep; consider running it off the critical path (after align-check).

units.name: Lens
units.necessity: States where we stand on the same coordinates: data on this machine, method families we can afford, our own data; feasibility reads only this.
units.trigger: After A7.A1 (parallel to A7.A2/A7.A3); again after a new env-probe (--reason).
units.legacy_deviation: The legacy card requires A7.A1 and env-probe only; v2 adds A1.v (D-12) because B1 reads A1.v's keys.

side_effects: build-methods re-renders the methods matrix view

logic: probe this machine (datasets on disk, packages, compute)
write the persona and verdicts on the same concepts (dataset on disk, method family affordable)
lens-set checks T01-T05
project affordable flags into the matrix input
units.state: Per topic; lens-stale caveat when the machine is probed again after lens-set.

error_boundary.local_recovery: missing data root is recorded, not fatal

units.idempotency: A re-probe changes the probe date; the lens must be re-set (caveat until then).
units.security: Reads the local filesystem roots named by the topic (lists at most 200 children); no network.

verdict.problem: Gaps and questions must be feasible here, not in general.
verdict.why_separate: Local, volatile facts kept apart from literature facts so a re-probe does not invalidate collisions.
verdict.if_removed: Feasibility would be judged from memory.
verdict.merge: A1.v could merge into B1 (see A1.v).
verdict.boundary: Owns lens.json, the probe part of step0, the affordable part of the matrix input.
verdict.dependencies: A7.A1 (concepts) and A1.v (persona inputs, made explicit in v2).

units.name: Collision candidates
units.necessity: Lists by rule which units are compared: same coordinates, shared premises, premise vs claim, numbers, lineage, convention vs lens, empty cells.
units.trigger: GATE-align-check passed; re-listed whenever coordinates, rows or the lens change.
logic: enumerate paper x paper candidates by rule
enumerate lens candidates (convention-vs-lens, empty-cell)
cap by depth and record the cut (candidates-cut, must disclose)

verdict.problem: Letting the model choose what to compare biases toward memorable conflicts.
verdict.merge: Into A7.X2 as its plan step (rejected: candidates are shared with B3.c).
verdict.risks: Depth cap may drop important candidates (disclosed).

units.name: Collision judgement
units.necessity: Judges every paper x paper candidate exactly once (agree, conflict, boundary, extends, analogy, premise relations, incommensurable, independent) with the sides and the axes on which they differ.

side_effects: projects 'Disagrees with:' into the notes view

logic: plan batches of 10 candidates
subagents judge each candidate once, naming sides and differing axes
merge checks H01-H06, H08 (every candidate judged, sides are members, conflicts have axes, no straight conflict on a hedge)
incommensurable -> align-set --reason (LOOP-05)
units.state: collisions.jsonl is append-only; the current judgement per candidate is the last one.

error_boundary.local_recovery: quick depth does not judge; unresolved incommensurable -> incommensurable-open (must disclose)

units.idempotency: Each candidate judged once; re-merging an identical answer appends nothing.

verdict.problem: Gaps asserted without a recorded comparison are unverifiable.
verdict.why_separate: 'Every candidate gets exactly one judgement' is a block invariant.
verdict.if_removed: B3 would have nothing to point to.
verdict.merge: Lens judgements are kept apart in B3.c.
verdict.duplication: Shares the plan/merge tooling with B3.c.
verdict.boundary: Owns the paper part of collisions.jsonl.
verdict.cost_risk: Large fan-out; golf50 judged all 138 candidates into 227 relations.
verdict.alternatives: LLM-written SOTA with implicit comparisons (original engine step 6).
verdict.benefits: Every claim of conflict or agreement is a record.

units.name: Lens collisions
units.necessity: Judges the field's conventions against this machine's lens: a convention we cannot follow, or a dataset x method cell nobody filled (absence only, severity <= 3).
logic: one model or subagent judges every lens candidate
empty cells count as absence only, severity capped at 3
merge checks H01

verdict.problem: Feasibility-driven gaps (what this lab can do that the field does not) are invisible in paper x paper comparisons.
verdict.why_separate: Different inputs (the volatile lens) and a different part of collisions.jsonl; merging into A7.X2 would make every literature judgement stale on a re-probe.
verdict.if_removed: B3 loses convention-vs-lens and empty-cell gaps.
verdict.merge: Into A7.X2 as an instance kind - rejected for staleness coupling.
verdict.boundary: Owns the lens part of collisions.jsonl.
verdict.alternatives: Feasibility scored inside B3 from memory.

units.name: Gap list
units.necessity: Writes the ranked gap list once per topic: every gap points to collisions and >= 2 supporting papers; its move follows the primary collision; scores and rank are computed.

context: full texts only for the verbatim source check

logic: write each gap with its collisions, supporting papers, type and move
verbatim source check against the full text
tool computes composite and rank with tie-break (W01-W10)
source check reading more than the record -> decon-merge --revise (LOOP-06)
units.state: Per topic, revised as a whole; gap ids never reused.
units.idempotency: gaps-set with the same list yields the same ranked file.

verdict.problem: 'Nobody did X' is absence, not a question worth asking (slide 6 trap).
verdict.why_separate: The only Unit that turns collisions into ranked opportunities.
verdict.if_removed: Questions would be written from intuition.
verdict.merge: With B3.5 would mix ranking and question writing.
verdict.risks: Ranking weights are a design choice.

units.name: Lines and findings points
units.necessity: Promotes collision groups: debate Lines (>= 2 sides), evolution Lines (chains of >= 3 papers), analogies; agree/boundary groups become findings Points.
logic: tool lists promotable groups
model writes Lines and findings Points, each citing its collisions
checks J01-J03
units.idempotency: Cards and lines keyed by slug.

verdict.problem: Collisions are too granular to reason with; Lines show debates and lineages.
verdict.why_separate: Assembly from collisions only (no new facts).
verdict.if_removed: Planes and the Body would lack structure; P1's rival ranking counts Lines.
verdict.merge: With A7.R2 would choose themes before seeing the lines.
verdict.boundary: Owns lines and one part of the cards.
verdict.alternatives: Fixed number of lines (legacy) - now no fixed count.

units.name: Planes
units.necessity: Chooses the themes after the collisions; every evidence paper in exactly one Plane; Q3/Q5 cite Lines and collisions.

side_effects: renders knowledge/planes/*.md and the _MANIFEST.md theme table

logic: group papers into themes after seeing collisions
each paper in exactly one Plane
Q3/Q5 cite Lines, collisions and the papers' limitation/future-work units
checks J04-J06

error_boundary.local_recovery: a paper in zero or two Planes fails J05

verdict.problem: Themes chosen before comparison follow keyword clusters, not the field's structure.
verdict.why_separate: Theme choice is its own judgement with a coverage invariant.
verdict.if_removed: B2 and A7.R3 have no thematic structure.
verdict.dependencies: A7.R1; reads A7.A3's Points (covered by align-check).
verdict.actions: Declare A7.A3 as an optional upstream in the registry.

units.name: Descriptive body
units.necessity: Answers the field's seven questions as a descriptive Body; Q3 cites evolution Lines and extends relations, Q5 debate Lines and conflicts.
logic: write the seven questions from Planes, Lines and collisions only
check J07
units.idempotency: Rewrite replaces the file; downstream only B6.2 reads it.

verdict.problem: A human-readable account of the field.
verdict.why_separate: A narrative distinct from B2's SOTA synthesis.
verdict.if_removed: No question, gap or gate depends on it; only B6.2 (prescriptive Body) uses it as based_on.
verdict.merge: Candidate to merge with B2 (both narrate Planes, Lines and collisions under the same cite-every-sentence rule).
verdict.dependencies: A7.R2; its consumer B6 does not declare it (covered by recon-check).
verdict.cost_risk: Blocks recon-check (Stage B start) although no planning step needs it.
verdict.alternatives: Generate it after Stage B starts, in parallel.
verdict.evidence: registry: A7.R3 invalidates B2 only; slide 4 right column.
verdict.benefits: Moving it off the critical path shortens time to the first idea.
verdict.risks: Readers of the knowledge base lose the descriptive Body if merged badly.
verdict.actions: Decide merge-with-B2 or non-blocking (owner: fusion block).

units.name: Synthesis (SOTA)
units.necessity: One topic-wide SOTA: consensus, debates and reported numbers, each citing a collision or matrix row id, otherwise (TBD).
logic: write consensus and debates only from collisions and the cards built on them
designs and numbers from the matrix
every statement cites an id or says (TBD)
check J08

verdict.problem: P2's design needs the field's reported numbers and designs in one place.
verdict.why_separate: Read by planning (P2); once per topic.
verdict.if_removed: P2 would read the matrix and lines directly.
verdict.merge: A7.R3 could merge into it (see A7.R3).
verdict.dependencies: A7.R2; its consumer P2 does not declare it (covered by recon-check).
verdict.alternatives: Per-angle SOTA per idea (legacy B2): convergent ideas (slide 6 trap).

units.name: Research questions
units.necessity: For the gaps in rank order, writes the problem and one research question each (common ground -> condition -> consequence -> one question -> screens), with the section-9 handover (attack targets, rival accounts, magnitudes).
units.trigger: After B3 (parallel to the A7.R series); extended on demand when ready questions run short.
logic: prefill from the gap's collisions (common ground from agree collisions)
write the condition, the consequence ladder from cited evidence, one question
four screens (settled, derivable, data, ...); failing -> rewrite once, then abandon
section 9 hands over attack targets, rival explanations and magnitudes
abstract-only targets -> full text (LOOP-07, cap 5)
units.state: One question per file, at most two per gap differing in move or axes.

error_boundary.local_recovery: a question failing its screens is rewritten once, then abandoned

units.security: No network itself (LOOP-07 goes through A6.d).

verdict.problem: Gaps are not questions; a question must survive screens and name what it attacks.
verdict.why_separate: Per-question writing with its own screens; parallel to the R series.
verdict.if_removed: Stage B would start from raw gaps (legacy B3.5 per idea).
verdict.merge: With F.9 (the index is derived from the questions).
verdict.alternatives: Question per idea inside Stage B (legacy).
verdict.benefits: Questions computed once per topic and consumed one per idea.

units.name: Index and views
units.necessity: Builds the hand-over questions/index.json (ready first, by gap rank, with the ready target) and the views fusion_map.md and concept_index.
logic: parse every question's front matter
sort ready first, then by gap rank
target_ready = max(max_num_generations or 3, 3) + 2
Y08 (hand edits), Y09 (ready short), J10 (map edited)

error_boundary.local_recovery: ready < target with gaps left -> warning Y09 (write more questions)
error_boundary.escalation: no ready question and none screen_unresolved -> error Y09

verdict.problem: Stage B needs one ordered, machine-readable list of what is ready.
verdict.why_separate: It is the fusion block's exit contract, checked against hand edits.
verdict.merge: Could be a view rebuilt by recon-check; kept as a Unit because it is the contract artifact.

substeps.name: Plan batches
substeps.purpose: Group papers into full-text and abstract batches; write one brief per batch.

substeps.name: Read each paper on its own (fan-out)
substeps.purpose: One subagent per batch writes one answer per paper from that paper alone.

substeps.name: Verify and merge
substeps.purpose: Verify every quote verbatim (D05) and write knowledge/decon/<key>.json; render notes.
substeps.error_boundary: A paraphrased quote rejects that record; others merge (per-item fan-in).

substeps.name: Plan batches
substeps.error_boundary: RP-NONE; collide-plan closes a Unit with nothing left to judge.

substeps.name: Judge (fan-out)
substeps.purpose: One judgement per candidate with sides and differing axes.

substeps.name: Check and append
substeps.purpose: Check H01-H06, H08 and append to collisions.jsonl.
